obligations.statement: The product must be a compact desktop storage box.
The product must include a reusable latch.
The box must open and close repeatedly without accidental opening during normal handling.
The latch must be easy for a user to operate while remaining secure during transport.
The product must be suitable for low-cost manufacturing and practical for desktop use.
The design must be mechanically plausible and easy to assemble.

candidates.summary: Latch using compliant flexure for relative motion and friction hold, with direct manual actuation.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Ideal-joint torque and back-drive under ideal joints

candidates.summary: Latch using revolute pair for relative motion and detent or snap for hold, with direct manual actuation.

unresolved.decision: Which latch mechanism (compliant flexure vs. revolute pair vs. prismatic pair) best balances ease of operation and security during transport.
unresolved.why_open: The requirements do not specify a quantitative balance between ease and security; this is a design trade-off.

assumptions.statement: The box will be operated by a single user.
assumptions.why: The request mentions 'a user' in relation to latch operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: Evidence that multiple users operate the latch simultaneously.

assumptions.statement: The box will be transported manually, not by any automated system.
assumptions.why: The request mentions 'during transport' without specifying means, implying manual handling.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: Specification of automated handling or specific transport standards.

assumptions.statement: The latch is intended to be operated by hand.
assumptions.why: The request mentions 'easy for a user to operate' and 'normal handling', which implies manual operation.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: Specification of tool-operated or automatic latch.
